input_boundary.only_input: A later same-origin transport may call the renderer only with one already server-validated final payload and source views.
input_boundary.answer: An answer has at most eight sources, nonempty bounded plain text, and at least one current local source.
input_boundary.nonanswer: clarify, abstain and refuse have empty text and no sources.

rendering.mode_copy: Each mode uses the locale-owned M10-03 answer/clarification/no-evidence/out-of-scope copy; no probability or numeric confidence is shown.
source_presentation: expandable display-safe excerpt only when supplied
rendering.local_link: Only a same-origin /help/{locale}/ path without query or supplied fragment is accepted. A validated non-root anchor is appended by the renderer.
rendering.external_link: Only an HTTPS URL without credentials is accepted, labelled external and opened with noopener noreferrer.
rendering.sink: All rendered labels, answer text and source metadata use createElement/textContent. Markup parsing and HTML insertion are forbidden.

boundaries.page_load: The renderer only registers a future-callable function. It makes no fetch, model check, retrieval, worker start, request, poll or DOM update on page load.
